capabilities: Generate Markdown answers for prompts in [!ai] callouts and embed them as nested callouts
Run local Codex, Claude Code, opencode, or Pi CLI agents with configurable model, effort, and timeout
Answer @agent mentions inside Inline Review Comments and Discussions threads
Show agent activity badges on notes and folders in the file explorer
Regenerate overviews on demand and protect hand-edited summaries by removing a metadata comment
disambiguation: Not a chat assistant or API client; it executes prompts stored in callouts via CLI agents you install and authenticate yourself.
extras: Desktop-only (generation starts a local CLI process and is unavailable on mobile); the plugin is free but model usage costs belong to the user's CLI setup; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README warns that hosted models may receive note content and that agent permissions are not a sandbox.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to generate AI content inside a note, so users must switch to a terminal or external tool and paste results back manually.
